backpacks.description: Durable carriers that expand your equipment slots, letting you haul more weapons, tools, and supplies into the field.

items.name: Tiny Bag
properties: Your maximum Inventory Slot increases by 2

items.name: Small Bag
properties: Your maximum Inventory Slot increases by 4

items.name: Medium Bag
properties: Your maximum Inventory Slot increases by 8

items.name: Large Bag
properties: Your maximum Inventory Slot increases by 12

items.name: Extra Large Bag
properties: Your maximum Inventory Slot increases by 20

gears.description: Essential mission tools offering a range of functions adaptable for any challenge.

items.name: Assassin’s Gear
properties: Your weapons gain the Sneak property and any Loud property is removed (up to 10 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Breathing Gear
properties: You can breathe normally up to 1 hour (replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Camping Gear
properties: You do not gain Exhausted and Fatigued after resting for 6 hours outdoors

items.name: Cooking Set
properties: Your entire party gains 5 Soak after resting for at least 3 hours

items.name: Comms Gear
properties: You can communicate with another person who is also equipped with this gear up to 50km

items.name: Climbing Gear
properties: Action/Reaction Dice to difficult climbs is increased by 2 sizes, you can climb 5m per 1 Stamina

items.name: Deciphering Tool
properties: Automatically succeed when solving puzzles and mysteries within 1m (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Disguise Kit
properties: Enemy Reaction Dice to notice or recognize you is decreased by 2 sizes

items.name: Expedition Gear
properties: You can move normally through difficult terrain, including underwater

items.name: Gliding Gear
properties: You glide and land safely from great heights

items.name: Hacking Tool
properties: Automatically succeed when bypassing technological devices and security codes within 5m (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Healing Kit
properties: Restores 5 Health to a creature out of combat (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Hunting Gear
properties: Action Dice to harvest plants, minerals, and animals is increased by 2 sizes

items.name: Language Tool
properties: You can speak and understand almost all languages

items.name: Liquor Flask
properties: Your Attack and Defense Dice increases by 2 sizes but your maximum Focus is reduced by 3 until combat ends (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Navigation Gear
properties: Automatically succeed when locating directions and items within 100m (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Night Gear
properties: You can see normally in total darkness

items.name: Repair Kit
properties: Restores 1d4 Durability or 1 Mitigation out of combat (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

items.name: Scouting Gear
properties: You can see normally up to 1,500m

items.name: Thieves’ Tools
properties: Automatically succeed when opening locks and disabling traps within 1m (up to 5 uses per day only, replenishes after resting for at least 6 hours)

trainings.description: Specialized instruction that boosts your potential, raising the maximum skill limits you can learn and master.

items.name: Proficiency Training
properties: Increase your maximum capacity to learn Proficiencies by 1.

items.name: Expertise Training
properties: Increase your maximum capacity to learn Expertise by 1.

items.name: Technique Training
properties: Increase your maximum capacity to learn Techniques by 1.
